title: Pod measurement harness: re-check of every signed card it produced
unsigned_reason: A re-check of our own pipeline. Signing it with our own key would add nothing a reader cannot get by re-running it; the inputs below are public and the method is deterministic.
honesty: This is our harness checking our own cards. It is not a third-party measurement, not on the board, not a grade of any model and not evidence about any model's accuracy. It scores the harness (did it produce a verifiable card over the bank it was supposed to use), never the model.

checks.id_recomputes: sha256 of the canonical body (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=True) equals card.id
checks.signature_valid: Ed25519 over those bytes verifies under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1, read live from https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, and again offline under the key pinned in packages/gspc-card-verifier/profile/csoai-gspc-1.json
checks.bank_pinned: compute_evidence.bank_sha256 is an allowlisted digest for the card's axis (scripts/runpod_gspc_bank_allowlist.current.json)
checks.root_inclusion: the card is a leaf of the dated card root /interop/card-root-latest.json points to; superseded cards and cards newer than the root abstain

population.not_attributed_means: cards not produced by the pod mill (other producers); not checked here

results.latency: not observed: cards are re-checked after the fact; never written as 0

the_33_and_the_32: All 33 bank_pinned failures are jail-axis cards graded on the placeholder bank f0f31f9a556266ce6f06660440b5ff819a19ee0b7801d72e78020a1ceda3a66e (runs of 5-14 Sep). Correction C-2026-0922-02 (/api/corrections) counts the 32 of them that carried status MEASURED; the 33rd, signed-jail-93152fee78d0.json (n=2), carried UNMEASURED and never claimed a measurement. It still counts here because this check asks whether the harness used the right bank, whatever the status. Two questions, two numbers; neither corrects the other. All 33 are superseded.
nothing_is_voted: Each component keeps its own verdict (CONFIRMED / REFUTED / CONTRADICTED / UNRESOLVED); there is no overall verdict.
reproduce: Take public/interop/mill-cards-signed/ and scripts/runpod_gspc_bank_allowlist.current.json from the site or repository.
For each signed-*.json whose body.model starts with 'ollama:' and whose compute_evidence.run_id is a pod run, apply the four checks above.
Count distinct cases by (model, axis) cell, keeping the latest card per cell for the case score.
refreshed: hourly on the measurement pod (loop harness-outcomes, :57); this file is the dated snapshot of 2026-09-24
